target_customer: Knowledge workers and professionals who want an AI agent to do multi-step work inside the sites they are logged into
problem: Agents that rely on integrations cannot reach most tools. Aside is a Chromium based browser whose agent works through the user's logged-in sites, with local memory and a password manager that hides credentials from the AI.
business_model: Consumer and prosumer subscription with credits (a third party lists Free, Pro 20 and Max 200 dollars per month; unverified)

founders.name: Jun Kim
founders.background_notes: YC page says he joined Airbridge.io at 17 and worked as a solutions consultant with 50+ reps.

founders.name: Chanhee Lee
previous_startups: Non-profit backed by Microsoft (founded at 15, per YC page)

founders.name: Sanghun Lee
founders.background_notes: YC page says he started coding at 14 and built an app with over 1M downloads.

competitors.name: Comet (Perplexity)
competitors.what: Chromium based AI browser with sidebar assistant using existing logins
competitors.traction_then: Initially limited to Max subscribers and early testers
competitors.funding_then: Perplexity was well funded (amount not verified here)

competitors.name: Dia (The Browser Company)
competitors.what: AI first browser, successor to Arc, in beta for Arc users

technical_complexity.rationale: Building on Chromium with a browser agent, local memory and credential isolation is heavy engineering, though agent models come from third parties.

defensibility.rationale: Features overlap with Comet, Dia and OpenAI and Chrome features; benchmark claims are the company's own.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large players launched AI browsers during 2025; no direct response aimed at Aside was found.

market_need_then: Interest in agentic browsing surged in 2025 with Comet, Dia and other launches, and many tasks live behind logins where API integrations are absent.

branding.domain_note: YC page points to AsideHQ.com; the product now lives at aside.com (a third party says AsideHQ was the older identity; not verified).

identity.voice_and_tone: confident, short and direct, emphasis on privacy and control

branding.community_and_virality: Third party coverage mentions a viral launch in mid 2026 and a founder article titled Goodbye YC Cluely; verified only through search summaries.

brand_strength.rationale: A common English word makes search harder, but there is steady product coverage in tech outlets and blogs in 2026.

pivots.from: Sales call assistant that surfaces answers from docs and past calls
pivots.to: AI browser that does work across logged-in sites
pivots.why: Founder article describes the earlier product as struggling (via search summary; date not stated)

outcome_analysis: Aside is an active Fall 2025 company that moved from a sales call assistant to an AI browser, which launched publicly in mid 2026 and has shipped frequent updates and a Windows version. The market is crowded with Perplexity, OpenAI and The Browser Company, and no verified funding round is public. Outcome is open.
notes: Unverified: 500K pre-seed in December 2025 (VCBacked and AngelBacked, same database family) and a 2M seed claim on Stork.ai. No round recorded. Pivot date is not given by sources. Competitor sources are dated 2025 broadly, not to the exact batch month. Round added: Asia Economic (asiae) reported on 2025-09-29 a pre-seed of 1 billion KRW from Y Combinator, The Ventures and AUM Ventures; USD amount not stated by the outlet. CB Insights lists $1M over 3 rounds including a $0.25M convertible note on 2025-10-01 and VCBacked $500K; conflicting, not recorded.
